value.data_conditioning: Audit all three frozen source/prepared images and captions, tokenizer truncation and trigger tokenization; keep data unchanged. No new data selected from holdout outcomes.
value.decision_rule: Reject any candidate with observed required-case failure; uncertain activation remains inconclusive. A setting can be promising for further evaluation without accepting a candidate.
value.exposure: Only two legacy regression cases. Seven C-01 holdouts and existing corpus bytes unchanged. No detector changes or automatic filtering.
value.inference_hypothesis: The 512px generation setting may contribute to collapsed counts/divided panels. Compare 512 versus 1024 while preserving prompt/seed/model/sampler. Compare strengths .25 versus 1 and plain versus trigger at both resolutions. No causal training claim from cross-runtime comparisons.
value.repetition_rule: Absolute maximum differences <=1e-6 for weights, optimizer moments and quantized losses; exact payload equality separate. No tolerance relaxation after results.
value.review: Inspect every diagnostic seed at every setting in all four roles; record adherence, panels/borders and activation specificity. Improvement must survive both seeds; adverse seeds remain. Unresolved differences inconclusive. Training and deployed-runtime findings separate.
value.runtime_bound: Each training worker <=900 seconds. Each deployed public run uses its owned job timeout; no new seeds, training retries, or adaptive endpoints.

value.limits: Independent final-checkpoint endpoints, each trained from its declared seed; repeated prefix work consumes the budget. Intermediate restart bundles are not evaluated. Selection is for further evaluation only, never production acceptance or promotion. Loss is diagnostic. Reviews inspect every frozen case, seed and all four conditions.

endpoints.hypothesis: Four updates may change adherence or untriggered regression beyond the observed repetition spread.

specification.hypothesis: Measure within-endpoint numerical variation before interpreting two versus four updates; all frozen legacy diagnostic seeds retained.

protocol.limitations: Three repetitions per endpoint estimate only observed variation, not population variance or causality. Exposed cases, same seed, two training works, 512px Diffusers diagnostics. Seven C-01 independent holdouts remain excluded. No promotion.
protocol.method: Inspect all four conditions for both legacy cases and both seeds in every repetition. Fail observed count, object identity, panel, or untriggered photographic-preservation defects; mark uncertain activation when painterly specificity is unresolved. Compare repetition ranges before duration. No loss-based selection. Same frozen two-work training data and one validation work; audit captions and images without changing selection. This old v1 suite calls the exposed pears case holdout; C-01 correctly classifies both legacy cases as diagnostic regressions.
